events.author: s_63h0z_rn9tGX5c93aI9sgKHb1iJO4JwP9NvPMuXsE
events.body:
## Summary

Reconstruct BLT-Jobs into a Git-native job platform where the repository is the source of truth for jobs, seeker profiles, future applications, and platform history.

The current implementation already has the right foundation: jobs and seeker profiles live as Markdown files, generated JSON powers a static frontend, GitLab issue templates collect submissions, CI processes accepted entries, and Cloudflare Workers hosts the public site. This parent issue turns that foundation into a coherent product direction.

## Product direction

BLT-Jobs should be a Git-native job platform, not a random job crawler and not a proprietary hiring dashboard.

Core principles:

- The Git repository is the data layer.
- Markdown files are the canonical job/profile records.
- Git history, issues, and merge requests provide the audit trail.
- GitLab is the first supported provider; abstractions should make GitHub and other Git-compatible hosts easy later.
- Maintainers review issues and merge requests; no external company verification is required in this phase.
- The frontend stays static and Cloudflare-hosted.
- Job seekers and future applicants should only need a Git username and email/contact preference.
- Public data boundaries must be explicit, especially for seeker profiles and future application flows.

## Existing implementation to preserve

- `jobs/*.md` for job listings.
- `seekers/*.md` for seeker profiles.
- `public/data/jobs.json` and `public/data/seekers.json` generated from Markdown.
- GitLab issue templates under `.gitlab/issue_templates/`.
- CI jobs for validation, submission processing, and expiry.
- Cloudflare Workers static deployment.
- Current landing-page visual direction from issue blt-jobs#1 should become the universal BLT-Jobs design language across all pages.

## Non-goals / constraints

- Do not turn BLT-Jobs into a random external jobs crawler.
- User-submitted job URLs are acceptable only as a way to generate a reviewable Git-native draft.
- Do not require external verification beyond maintainer review in this phase.
- Do not store sensitive application data publicly without an explicit privacy decision.
- Do not introduce a database/backend dependency for this phase.

## Child issue map

- [ ] Existing design seed: blt-jobs#1 feat: update landing page UI — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/issues/1
- [ ] blt-jobs#3 Define BLT-Jobs Git-native architecture and provider contract — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/3
- [ ] #13 Apply universal BLT-Jobs design system across all pages — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/4
- [ ] #14 Rework job and profile submission into Git-native Markdown draft flows — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/5
- [ ] #15 Expand Markdown schemas and validation for jobs, seekers, and organizations — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/6
- [ ] #16 Add maintainer review states, source traceability, and board health — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/7
- [ ] #17 Design privacy-safe Git-native applications and seeker contact flows — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/8
- [ ] #18 Document federation, mirroring, GitHub readiness, and contributor workflow — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/9
- [ ] #19 QA Git-native platform reliability, accessibility, and static build flow — https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/10

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] BLT-Jobs has a clear Git-native architecture and product contract.
- [ ] GitLab-first implementation remains stable while GitHub/generic Git are planned as provider abstractions.
- [ ] The landing page visual direction becomes a reusable design system for all pages.
- [ ] Jobs, seekers, organizations, source traceability, and review status are represented in Markdown schemas and generated JSON.
- [ ] Job/profile submission flows generate reviewable Git-native artifacts.
- [ ] Maintainer review remains the trust model for issues and merge requests.
- [ ] Public data/privacy rules are documented for seeker profiles and future application flows.
- [ ] Board health, source traceability, and static data loading are reliable and visible.
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` records this issue map and implementation sequence.
- [ ] `npm run build:jobs` and `npm run validate:jobs` pass after implementation changes.

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/issues/2 (opened by @mdkaifansari04 on 2026-06-07).

**Discussion summary**

- GitLab is no longer the first provider: the repository is now git.owaspblt.org/BLT (folder `blt-jobs`), with issue templates in `issue-templates/` and forge submission workflows. Child blt-jobs#3 (architecture) is done.
